name: Storm Warlock
summary: Storm Warlock; When you deal force, lightning, fire, or radiant damage with a psychic power, add +1 damage per die.  Storm Warlock; Once per turn, when a psychic power damages a creature, push it 5 ft.  Storm Warlock; Your first damaging psychic power each combat deals +1d8 damage.  Storm Warlock; Your Storm Warlock push increases to 10 ft.
